title: Surreal Mystic Nightscape
description: A surreal fantasy scene depicts a kneeling man in green military-style uniform at the edge of reflective water. A glowing circular portal reveals a waterfall and sunset, while a large green bubble contains a skeleton and an alien creature. A hooded wizard floats near a giant smiling crescent moon with blue eyes shooting lightning, accompanied by a black cat. A striped lighthouse stands on the right.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene with a soldier in green uniform kneeling in shallow reflective water, a glowing yellow portal showing a waterfall at sunset, a large green bubble containing a skeleton and green alien, a black cat leaping, a hooded wizard in blue robes floating in the sky holding a staff with lightning, a giant smiling crescent moon with blue eyes and cracks, a green and white striped lighthouse on rocks, vibrant cosmic sky with stars and colorful clouds
